text:
devon.p: Hello all, I'm trying to finish onboarding but hit a snag. I accepted the Okta invite but during MFA setup it fails with "clientDataJSON error". I'm on macOS Monterey, Chrome.

olivia-peopleops: Welcome Devon! :wave: We typically see that when a browser extension interferes or when a personal Apple passkey exists. Can you try an incognito window first? Also confirm you're using devon.p@redwood.com.

devon.p: Yep using devon.p@redwood.com. Incognito gave the same error. I have 1Password extension and my personal Google SSO extension.

sam-it: Hi Devon 1 Quick troubleshooting: 1) Disable 1Password extension temporarily (it can inject and break WebAuthn). 2) In Chrome url bar, go to chrome://webauthn to see any flags (if enabled). 3) If you still see the error, try Safari — macOS passkeys tend to be more reliable there.

devon.p: Disabled 1Password extension and retried. Now it gets past the prompt but then OKTA returns "registration failed: unknown attestation".

omta-broken: (this is a fake bot message to emulate noise)

maria-eng: random tip: if you see attestation issues it's sometimes because the platform authenticator returns a different attestation format. We accept most standard attestation but older browsers can be weird.

sam-it: Could you try registering a security key instead (YubiKey) if you have one? If not, try Safari and allow passkey creation from your Apple ID when prompted.

devon.p: I don't have a YubiKey. Switched to Safari and it let me create a passkey, but after redirect Okta still shows me as "MFA incomplete".

okta-bot: Okta: Enrollment attempted for devon.p@redwood.com. Status: pending registration.

sam-it: Hmm. That suggests the attestation completed client-side but our IdP didn't persist it. I'm going to force re-sync your Okta session from the admin console. Give me a sec.

sam-it: Re-synced the session and forced re-registration token. Try the flow again in Safari (clear the tab and start fresh).

devon.p: That worked! Passkey enrolled and Okta shows ACTIVE. 1Password invite arrived a few minutes later. Thanks everyone.

olivia-peopleops: Awesome, welcome aboard Devon! If any provisioning emails are missing, DM me and we'll do a manual SCIM provision. :tada:
